limitations: One machine; not a hardware portability claim. Reference versions are manifest-pinned versions, not independent runtime attestations.
Ratios are Assay/reference elapsed time; values greater than one are losses. All 22 queries in all four lanes remain visible.
Marginal 95% bootstrap bounds use three round clusters; 15 samples are not 15 independent observations.
Exporter rehashes every indexed artifact and checks accounting and point estimates; it does not rerun SQL, rescore answers or recompute bootstrap bounds.
Build linkage, clean source and timestamps are operator attestations. CI does not rehash private raw artifacts. This is not a proof.

bootstrap.interval: marginal percentile95; three round clusters and15 measured samples per engine/query, not15 independent observations; no hardware portability claim
bootstrap.point_estimator: M3 pooled total ratio of sums over66 query-round medians; geometric mean of66 paired ratios
bootstrap.query_seconds_estimator: arithmetic mean of three round medians; gap ratio of sums over those three rounds
